changes: Kept exact workflow run head_sha as the immutable implementation binding while removing the false requirement that GitHub's nested pull_requests current-head relation stay on the historical implementation commit.
Bound PR-context evidence to PR number, exact task branch and exact base SHA, preserving workflow ID/path/event/repository checks.
Added positive regression for an evidence-descendant PR head and negative regression for a wrong task branch.
